reviews.review: when you play multi-player most people do no get over 60 frames per second  20-40 fps is average i would suggest googling average fps arma 3 ETC. My pc easily meets the recommended game settings but after doing alot of research it seems like the game is not optimized and people are happy playing a game with low fps. I play alot of first person shooter and fps makes a big difference so be carefull buying this game as i regret it.

A fantastic military sandbox with many addons & mods to experiment with. It has its fair share of cons and pros, the cons laying mostly with the multiplayer portion of the game and the decency of your PC.

If you intend to buy this game, I recommend upgrading the specs on your PC to something of above average. I'm not saying that if you have a PC with not as up-to-date specs that you won't have the same ArmA3 experience, I'm just saying that in order to get more out of this game you may want to consider doing so.

Singleplayer is fantastic. With the steamworks support and modding support this game has, singleplayer is a blast aside from the campaign. Definitely a game aimed at more hardcore players, singleplayer dishes out an amazing campaign as well as scenario missions. You'll notice that in singleplayer the game is easier to run and achieve higher fps.

Multiplayer is a piece of work, it really depends whos hosting, what gamemode you are playing, and if your PC specs are able to handle the stress. Playing gamemodes like Altis Life and King of The Hill you'll notice that you are able to play on nicer graphics settings and achieve higher fps than playing modes like Capture the Island or Cooperative (Invade & Annex). Playing the latter 2 you might find yourself having to run at lower settings and/or have lower fps. This doesn't mean you won't be able to enjoy these gamemodes for yourself, it just means all those snazzy, jazzy looks and feels won't be high end.

Away from the cons and on to the pros, this game is one of the best military sims/sandboxes out there. With ArmA3's many details and functions you can find yourself commanding a squadron of soldiers into battle, relaxing on an tropical island, or even building your own mission. Whether you are a hardcore or casual gamer, this game has got you covered.

All in all, I'd give this game a 9/10
